name: Three-Act Structure
description: Classic three-act dramatic structure. Act I sets up the ordinary world and the call to action; Act II confronts escalating obstacles toward the midpoint shift; Act III resolves the climb and closes the arc.

children.title: The Ordinary World
children.synopsis: Establish the protagonist's everyday life, voice, and wants before anything changes.

scenes.title: Status Quo
scenes.synopsis: Show the protagonist's routines, relationships, and quiet longing.

children.title: Inciting Incident
children.synopsis: A disruption forces a change the protagonist cannot ignore.

scenes.title: The Disruption
scenes.synopsis: An event or message cracks the ordinary world open.

children.title: The Hooked Choice
children.synopsis: The protagonist weighs the cost and chooses to act on the disruption.

scenes.title: Decision
scenes.synopsis: The protagonist commits, setting the story's central goal in motion.

children.title: Rising Action
children.synopsis: Allies, enemies, and escalating attempts create momentum and deepen stakes.

scenes.title: First Attempts
scenes.synopsis: Early wins and losses sharpen the goal and its true cost.

scenes.title: Complications
scenes.synopsis: A new obstacle forces a change of plan.

children.title: Midpoint
children.synopsis: A major turn: the protagonist moves from reaction to action and the stakes shift.

scenes.title: The Turning Point
scenes.synopsis: A revelation or decision raises the cost of failure.

children.title: Darkest Push
children.synopsis: The antagonist tightens their grip; the protagonist teeters on defeat.

scenes.title: Pressure Mounts
scenes.synopsis: Everything the protagonist wants slips toward ruin.

children.title: All Is Lost
children.synopsis: The lowest point: hope collapses and the protagonist must find a deeper resolve.

scenes.title: The Fall
scenes.synopsis: A final failure strips away the protagonist's illusions.

children.title: Climax
children.synopsis: The protagonist faces the central conflict with everything on the line.

scenes.title: The Showdown
scenes.synopsis: The decisive confrontation resolves the story's central question.

children.title: Resolution
children.synopsis: The new normal, showing how the protagonist and world have changed.

scenes.title: Aftermath
scenes.synopsis: Close the arc and leave a resonant final image.
